laura: Quick sync — need a short decision on flag domain boundaries for the reroute rollout. Should the route-level toggle be allowed to override a project block? I want a clear rule we can document and enforce in the UI/CLI.

devon: tl;dr: route overrides are allowed but must be explicit and auditable. no silent backdoors. :lock:

samir: +1 on explicitness. also suggest a policy: org > project > route > model, with an opt-in precedence flip for emergency route-level unblocks.

mari: can you explain "opt-in precedence flip"? worried about accidental bypass of org guardrails.

samir: sure — default precedence stays org>project>route>model. a route can be allowed to override project only if the project owner grants an exception (flag metadata: "route_override:true" + approver id). store exception in audit log.

tess: does that mean the route flag value is evaluated after checking for an approved exception? so evaluate: if org denies -> deny; else if project denies -> check for approved route override -> if approved, allow route value, else deny; then model level applies?

laura: exactly. pseudocode we can use in docs: ```
if org.denied: result = denied
elif project.denied:
  if route.has_override && route.override.approved: result = route.value
  else: result = denied
else: result = route.value if route.set else model.value
```

devon: operational notes: overrides must have TTL and owner handback. no permanent exceptions. set default TTL=72h and require reapproval or revoke.

mari: +1 TTL. Also we need a clear UI affordance: show effective source (org/project/route/model) and link to override approval. Please add to RFC.

laura: will add to RFC. quick question: if a model bundle includes an embedded flag (model-scoped), does it ever trump route when route is unspecified? I think model should be lowest precedence (only applies when route/project/org don't set).

samir: yes model is lowest. model flags are runtime defaults for the model consumer. they shouldn't override explicit route/project/org decisions.

opsbot: NOTE: created approval-template "route-override-request" (id: r-override-2024) — use this for audit hooks.

devon: action items: laura to update RFC with pseudocode and UI mock; mari to add TTL and owner-revoke UX; samir to draft audit schema for exceptions; I'll add tests for evaluation order in flag-resolver.

laura: thanks — I'll ping for a quick review when RFC draft is up. If no objections by EOD Friday we'll adopt this as the interim rule. :wave:
